detail.readme:
# MediaPipe Tasks for Flutter

Google's [MediaPipe] Tasks for Dart and Flutter on Android, iOS, macOS, Linux, Windows and the web: detect faces and objects, track face, hand and pose landmarks, recognize gestures, classify and embed images, text and audio, segment images, and more. Every task runs Google's official MediaPipe runtime for its platform, with Google's pinned models bundled at build time. [MediaPipe]: https://developers.google.com/edge/mediapipe/solutions **[Try the live gallery](https://google.github.io/flutter-mediapipe/)** ## Which package do I need? | Package | Use it for | Install | Guide | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [`mediapipe_vision`](https://pub.dev/packages/mediapipe_vision) | Face and object detection; face, hand, pose and holistic landmarks; gestures; image classification, embeddings and segmentation | `flutter pub add mediapipe_vision` | [Vision](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-vision/README.md) | | [`mediapipe_text`](https://pub.dev/packages/mediapipe_text) | Text classification, embeddings (EmbeddingGemma included) and language detection on every platform; proofreading and summarization on every platform except the web, where they are not yet available | `flutter pub add mediapipe_text` | [Text](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-text/README.md) | | [`mediapipe_audio`](https://pub.dev/packages/mediapipe_audio) | Audio classification, speech to text and text to speech, on every platform | `flutter pub add mediapipe_audio` | [Audio](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-audio/README.md) | | [`mediapipe_decision`](https://pub.dev/packages/mediapipe_decision) | Yes-or-no, choice and score questions about a text (Decision Maker), on every platform | `flutter pub add mediapipe_decision` | [Decision](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-decision/README.md) | | [`mediapipe_retrieval`](https://pub.dev/packages/mediapipe_retrieval) | Text, images and audio in one embedding space (Universal Embedder) and an on-device vector index over them (Semantic Retriever), on every platform | `flutter pub add mediapipe_retrieval` | [Retrieval](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-retrieval/README.md) | Add only the families you use: each one bundles only Google's MediaPipe library for that family. Every family brings `mediapipe_core`, which holds the shared download code, model store and browser runtime settings ([core guide](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/doc/mediapipe_core.md)), and exports its types, so you do not add or import core yourself unless your own code imports `package:mediapipe_core/...`. ## Quick start The packages need Flutter 3.44 or newer; the latest stable release is recommended. iOS and macOS builds with Xcode 27 need Flutter 3.47 or later. Add a family from pub.dev, from your app's root: ```sh flutter pub add mediapipe_vision ``` This adds `mediapipe_vision: ^0.3.0` to your app's `pubspec.yaml`. List the models your app uses in the same pubspec, and declare the folder they are bundled in: ```yaml flutter: assets: - assets/mediapipe/ hooks: user_defines: mediapipe_vision: models: [face_landmarker] ``` Then bundle them from the app's root, and again whenever the list changes: ```sh dart run mediapipe_core:bundle_models ``` It downloads each listed model once, checks it against its pinned SHA-256 and writes it into `assets/mediapipe/`, so the model ships inside your app: nothing is downloaded at run time, and the app works offline from its first launch. In CI, `dart run mediapipe_core:bundle_models --check` fails when the folder does not match the list. Each family's `XxxModels.byName` lists the names it accepts. Now create a task with the bundled model: ```dart import 'dart:typed_data'; import 'package:mediapipe_vision/mediapipe_vision.dart'; Future countFaces(Uint8List rgba, int width, int height) async { final landmarker = await FaceLandmarker.create( FaceLandmarkerOptions(model: VisionModels.faceLandmarker), ); try { final result = await landmarker.detect( VisionImage.fromPixels( pixels: rgba, width: width, height: height, format: VisionPixelFormat.rgba, ), ); return result.faceLandmarks.length; } finally { await landmarker.dispose(); } } ``` A model that is not bundled makes `create` throw a `RuntimeUnavailableException` whose `fix` names the pubspec entry to add. To download models at run time instead, set `ModelStore.allowDownloads = true` before creating tasks; Android then needs the `INTERNET` permission, and a sandboxed macOS app the network client entitlement. On macOS, build the app for Apple Silicon only (two lines in its `AppInfo.xcconfig`; without them, release builds fail). See [platform setup](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/doc/platform_setup.md#macos). Your own models work too: pass `modelPath` or `modelBytes` instead of `model`. ## Where it runs | Family | Android | iOS | macOS arm64 | Linux x64 | Windows x64 | Web | | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | | Vision | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Text (classify, embed, detect language) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Text (EmbeddingGemma) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Text (proofread, summarize) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | | Audio | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Audio (transcribe, speak) | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Decision | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | | Retrieval | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | ✓ | Every text task runs on every platform listed except Text Proofreader and Text Summarizer, which are not yet available on the web, matching the MediaPipe Tasks Web SDK. CPU works everywhere a family is listed, except that browsers run Decision and Retrieval on WebGPU alone, which needs a hardware adapter. GPU (Metal, OpenGL ES, WebGL, WebGPU or Android GPU) depends on the task; Macs run the vision tasks on the CPU for now, until Google confirms its Metal results since 1.1.1. On iPhones, Metal is offered for nine vision tasks and Audio Transcriber, tested on an iPhone 15 Pro (iOS 27) with Google's 1.2.2 library; iPads were not tested. Every cell is tested in CI on hosted runners, the Android emulator, the iOS Simulator and Chromium, Firefox and WebKit. The [vision status table](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-vision/tool/VISION_TASKS_STATUS.md) lists each task, delegate, known upstream limit and physical-device result. Ask at run time with the `queryXxxCapabilities()` functions: they report the supported delegates and why any other is unavailable. ## More - Samples for every task: [vision](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-vision/README.md#samples-for-every-task), [text](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-text/README.md#quick-start), [audio](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-audio/README.md#use), [decision](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-decision/README.md#quick-start) and [retrieval](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/packages/mediapipe-task-retrieval/README.md#quick-start). - [Object detection guide](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/doc/guides/vision/object_detector.md), with a [sample app](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/tree/main/samples/apps/object_detection/) for every platform, following Google's Android guide and sample. - [Video and live stream samples](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/doc/guides/vision/video_and_live_stream.md) for every camera-capable vision task. - [Vision options and extra outputs](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/doc/guides/vision/options_and_outputs.md): regions of interest, RGB input, masks, matrices and every capability query. - [Platform setup](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/doc/platform_setup.md): permissions, entitlements, minimum OS versions, offline builds and browser hosting. - [Privacy and licenses](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/doc/privacy_and_licenses.md): what is downloaded, from where, and under which license. - [Migration](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/MIGRATION.md) from Google's `mediapipe_text` and `mediapipe_core` 0.0.1 previews. - [Gallery](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/gallery/README.md): the full demo app, also [live on GitHub Pages](https://google.github.io/flutter-mediapipe/). - [Contributing](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md), including how to add a task. ## Origin and license Source is licensed under [Apache-2.0](https://github.com/google/flutter-mediapipe/blob/main/LICENSE), with upstream notices retained.
